sqlpipe v2.0

BREAKING CHANGE: The `name` field of the `/v2/users` endpoint is now two fields, `first_name` and `last_name`. Update your client code to use these two fields before you upgrade. After the upgrade, requests that read the old `name` field will fail.

New feature: The `--incremental` flag runs a sync that transfers only new and changed rows. Use this flag to reduce the time of a sync on large tables.

Performance: Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1. This change affects all export commands that use the Parquet format.

If you use the `name` field in your code, read the migration guide before you upgrade.
